desc: The CZ P-10 C is much more than just our take on the striker-fired pistol, from the way it feels to the way it shoots. The CZ grip angle, a mild palm swell, deep beavertail, and three interchangeable backstraps make the gun fit a wide variety of hands as if it were built for them. Designed to minimize creep and stacking, the P-10's trigger breaks at a clean 4-4.5 lbs and rebounds with a short, positive reset, meaning single shots can be meticulously placed while follow-ups are effortless. Its fiber-reinforced polymer frame and hardy nitride finish are made for the daily grind. A generous trigger guard allows use with gloved hands while being undercut to allow as high a grip as possible, and a set of metal tactical 3-dot sights allow for one-handed manipulation of the slide on a belt. Like all CZ pistols, the P-10 is built with our legendary cold hammer forged barrel. The C in the name indicates that it is compact in both frame and slide size.
